Audre's Revenge Film Presents
A MONIKA ESTRELLA NEGRA PRODUCTION
"Audre's Revenge" is a collective creative endeavor to promote visibility of QTPOC in the Sci-Fi/Horror Universe. We hope to create a space for retired film makers, writers, actors and artists, to reprioritize timeless and important work.
